title: thelypteris lebeufii
intro: Thelypteris lebeufii, commonly known as Lebeuf's fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris lebeufii include its ability to reduce inflammation, prevent cell damage, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
